task_type_fields.why_not_flake: The same five symbols were reported by repeated standalone lint runs and wrapped checks on the same source tree; the source file was unchanged, so this deterministic static analysis failure is not intermittent.

issue.creation_reason: The required lint and check runs repeatedly fail on a separate source module, and SASE classifies these findings as new and unowned. Recording the distinct file-level failure keeps it actionable without expanding this test split.

fields.description: The lint gate reports these five symbols in src/sase/axe/runner_kill_provenance.py as unused public API: KillProvenance, classify_runner_kill, format_kill_classification, oom_kill_evidence, and reset_oom_baseline. Repository search finds uses within the defining module and tests, but no production imports from other modules. Repeated just _lint-symvision runs and sase tool run check runs fail consistently on this unchanged source file. Decide which names are intended public API; add real production consumers where needed, or make/remove file-local implementation and test-support symbols.
